 The UM Scholars at the University of Maryland School of Medicine (UMSOM) is a unique summer enrichment experience that connects undergraduate students from University of Maryland, College Park (UMCP) with top UMSOM faculty at the University of Maryland, Baltimore (UMB). 
 UM Scholars at UMSOM provides participating students with in-depth involvement in significant research and professional mentorship in challenging settings. The program also introduces highly talented UMCP undergraduates to the MD degree program, a vast array of graduate degree programs, and the MD/PhD and MD/MS degree opportunities at UMB.
 Eligibility for this program is limited to undergraduate students at the University of Maryland, College Park (UMCP). 
 UM Scholars is a signature initiative of the University of Maryland Strategic Partnership: MPowering the State (MPower) . UM Scholars at UMSOM is administered by the University of Maryland School of Medicine Office of Student Research (OSR). 
 Join our mailing list for the latest updates!
